text:
rina: Pushed a small update to the Credentials empty state + bulk action flows. Main ask: sanity-check copy and safety behavior for bulk revoke. Figma link: https://figma.com/snap/cred-empty-bulk. devon: Quick look 00% agree on clearer affordances. Empty state idea: call out next steps (create key, view docs, restore examples) rather than just an illustration. Make the primary CTA 'Create API key' not 'Get started'. sam: A11y quick notes: ensure the empty state has a clear h1 semantics and the primary CTA is focusable by default. For keyboard users, the bulk action menu should be reachable via keyboard shortcut (e.g., "M" when list focused). anika: Copy thoughts for empty state (concise): header "No API keys yet" body "Create a key to connect services and scripts" primary CTA "Create API key" secondary links: "How keys work", "Rotate best practices". devon: Bulk revoke safety: propose two-tier protection: if selection <=5, show confirmation modal with list preview; if >5, require typing the word "REVOKE" and show an impact estimate. This prevents accidental mass outages. sam: Impact estimate UX: show a line "Approx. affected endpoints: ~4" with tooltip explaining it9s an estimate based on recent usage. For SR users, indicate last-used timestamp. rina: What about a staging toggle? In Dedicated/Private customers we can surface "Apply to staging only" for queued revokes so they can simulate without breaking prod. Might complicate the UI but good for enterprise workflows. anika: Regarding rotate vs revoke tone: rotate should be positioned as the low-friction option. Suggested rotate modal copy: header "Rotate key" body "Creates a new key and keeps the current key active for up to 120 seconds to allow cutover. Update your services to start using the new key." primary CTA "Rotate and copy" secondary "Cancel". devon: Revoke modal copy (explicit): header "Revoke API key" body "This will invalidate the key immediately. Any requests using it will fail and services may be disrupted." destructive CTA "Revoke key" secondary "Cancel". Add a small checklist: "Not sure? Try Rotate first." sam: Accessibility implementation notes: when modal opens focus moves to the modal title; tab order inside modal should be: title/description -> tertiary details (affected apps) -> cancel -> primary destructive. This lets keyboard users back out quickly. Also ensure Esc closes modal and ARIA role=dialog with aria-modal=true. rina: UX pattern for the impact number: calculate server-side, but show a grace marker if it's incomplete: "~3 endpoints (calculated from last 90 days)". If we can't compute, fallback to "Impact unknown" and surface a help link. anika: UI microcopy for bulk typed-confirm: "Type REVOKE to confirm bulk revocation of 12 keys". For fewer items, show the list and a single-step confirm. devon: Visual density: permission chips are noisy. New idea: show compact pills only for keys with >3 permissions, otherwise inline text "read,write". On focus, show full list in a popover. sam: Small a11y snippet for dialog: ```html

Revoke API key

This will invalidate the key immediately. Any requests using it will fail.

``` Make sure the dialog traps focus. rina: Edge case: deleting a key that9s already revoked should not show the typed-confirm. For bulk operations, we should deduplicate and show counts of "already revoked" vs "will be revoked". anika: Action items: I'll update the empty state copy, add bulk threshold logic to the spec, and wire the typed-confirm UI for >5 items. Sam, can you add the a11y checklist to the PR template? Devon, can you sketch the compact permission pill behavior? I'll drop updated mocks in ~30m. matt-bot: Design review created by rina. Reviewers: devon, sam, anika. Due: 48h.
